description: Stream eventsStream's events. GET /sandboxes/{sandboxId}/events/stream answers 200 application/x-ndjson, one EventStreamFrame per line (the spec's own components.schemas.EventStreamFrame), but the converter reads only application/json bodies, so the operation generated with an empty output. Mark it server-streaming with the frames as its output's items, so it generates as API.makeStreaming: `.stream(input)` emits each frame as Boat writes it, and BoatProtocol frames the body as NDJSON. The frame shape is transcribed from that schema.

traits.smithy.api#documentation:
One line of `GET /sandboxes/{sandboxId}/events/stream` (application/x-ndjson).
- `text_delta`: reply text as the model writes it. `conversationId`, `promptId`, `messageId`, `text`, and `offset`: the number of characters of `messageId` sent before this line. A stream that opens in the middle of a reply gets the text so far at `offset` 0.
- `event`: one event, the same object that `GET /events` returns. It is sent again when the event changes (a tool result arrives): replace the event with the same `event.id`. `cursor` continues the stream after this event. `streamedMessageIds` names the `text_delta` messages whose text `event.data.content` now records: if you showed those texts, do not show the content again. Without `streamedMessageIds`, the text was not streamed: show the content.
- `heartbeat`: sent after 15 s with no other line.
- `done`: last line, only with `promptId`, when that prompt ended. `promptRun` is the object of `GET /sandboxes/{sandboxId}/prompts/{promptId}`.
- `reconnect`: last line after 10 minutes. Open the stream again with its `cursor`.
- `error`: last line on a failure. `error`, `message`.
Every line of the event stream, in order. It ends after a `done`, `reconnect` or `error` frame.
